subject: Create Johnny dashboard: Add tab navigation structure
description:
Add tab-based navigation to the Johnny page for Episodes, Timeline, Sessions, Capture, Analytics in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/frontend-design` for UI/UX implementation, `/optimized-nextjs-typescript` for patterns.

**Scope:**
- Add tab navigation component to Johnny page
- Implement 5 tabs: Episodes (current content), Timeline, Sessions, Capture, Analytics
- Move current memory list to Episodes tab
- Create placeholder components for new tabs
- Implement tab state management (URL-based or local state)

**Design Requirements:**
- Tabs should be visually consistent with Agent Hub design system
- Active tab clearly indicated
- Tab content area with smooth transitions
- Mobile-responsive tab layout

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/app/johnny/page.tsx
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/JohnnyTabs.tsx (new)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/EpisodesTab.tsx (refactored from current)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/TimelineTab.tsx (new placeholder)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/SessionsTab.tsx (new placeholder)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/CaptureTab.tsx (new placeholder)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/AnalyticsTab.tsx (new placeholder)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Tab navigation renders with 5 tabs
- [ ] Episodes tab shows existing memory list
- [ ] Other tabs show placeholder content
- [ ] Tab switching works smoothly
- [ ] Active tab visually distinguished
- [ ] Mobile responsive
- [ ] `rebuild.sh --frontend` completed (in agent-hub)
- [ ] Verified in browser

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
